title: Ukitaka kuendesha baiskeli Korea, tumia baiskeli za pamoja za jiji la Seoul
label: Baiskeli za pamoja za Seoul

text.The bikes in Korea were very easy to rid: Baiskeli za Korea zilikuwa rahisi sana kuendesha.
text.I rented the bike near Lotte World in Se: Nilikodisha baiskeli karibu na Lotte World mjini Seoul.
text.There are 2 kinds of rental bikes in Kor: Kuna aina mbili za baiskeli za kukodi Korea.
text.Bikes that the Seoul city government off: Baiskeli zinazotolewa na serikali ya jiji la Seoul na zinazotolewa na kampuni binafsi za Korea.
text.The price is totally different between t: Bei za aina hizi mbili zinatofautiana kabisa.

text.This green bike is probably run by a pri: Huenda baiskeli hii ya kijani inaendeshwa na kampuni binafsi ya Korea.
text.But I think it cost about 1,000 yen for: Lakini nadhani iligharimu takriban yen 1,000 kwa saa moja.

text.The hard part was that when I tried to i: Kilichokuwa kigumu ni kwamba nilipojaribu kusakinisha programu ya baiskeli ya Seoul baada ya kufika Korea, ilikuwa changamoto.

Huo ndio majuto na funzo langu.
text.If you want to ride a bike and move arou: Ukitaka kuendesha baiskeli na kutalii kwa gharama nafuu Korea, huenda ikafaa kupakua programu ya baiskeli za pamoja ya jiji la Seoul kabla ya kwenda.
